objective: Render a Discord release note from merged mission work — RENDER ONLY, no posting. Add bot/release_notes.py exposing collect_release(repo, since_ref, until_ref) and render_release(data) -> str|None, following the shape of the existing bot/digest.py (collect_/render_ split, MAX_DISCORD_MESSAGE truncation, None when there is nothing to say). It summarises merged mission commits — task id, one-line what-changed, PR/issue refs — into a message under 1900 chars. It MUST NOT import discord, open a network connection, or post anything; wiring it to the live announce channel is a separate operator-gated stage (S2). Add bot/tests/test_release_notes.py covering: a normal multi-commit range, an empty range returning None, truncation past MAX_DISCORD_MESSAGE, and a commit with no task id.

acceptance_criteria.text: bot/release_notes.py exposes collect_release and render_release; render_release returns None for an empty range and a string under 1900 chars otherwise.
The module does not import discord and makes no network call — posting is out of scope for this stage.
bot/tests/test_release_notes.py covers the normal, empty, truncated and no-task-id cases, and passes.
